description.short_caption: Abdominal MRI showing liver abscesses with hypointense lesions.
description.detailed_description: This is an axial abdominal MRI scan showing the liver. Two hypointense lesions are visible in the liver parenchyma, marked by red arrows, suggestive of abscesses. The surrounding liver tissue appears relatively normal. The image provides good contrast between the lesions and the surrounding tissue, aiding in the identification of the abnormalities.

description.short_caption: Adrenal gland aspirate with fungal elements visible on special stain.
description.detailed_description: This is a microscopic image of an adrenal gland aspirate stained with a special fungal stain, likely Gomori methenamine silver (GMS). The image shows numerous small, darkly stained fungal elements against a green background, consistent with fungal hyphae or yeast forms. The staining highlights the fungal structures, making them easily distinguishable from the surrounding tissue.
visible_findings: green background indicating special fungal stain
